question: A rectangular garden 20 m × 14 m has four full circular flowerbeds of radius 2 m placed within it. What is the area left for grass?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of rectangle = 20 × 14 = 280

Area of 1 circle = π × 2² = 4π

4 circles → total = 16π

Take π = 22/7 → 16π = 352/7 ≈ 50.29

Area left = 280 − 50.29 ≈ 229.71

**∴ Answer ≈ 229.7 m²**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length = 20 m, Breadth = 14 m

Radius of each circle = 2 m, Number of circles = 4

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = l × b

Area of circle = πr²

 20 m 14 m 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area of rectangle = 20 × 14 = 280 m²

⇒ Area of 1 circle = π × 2² = 4π

⇒ Area of 4 circles = 16π

⇒ Using π = 22/7 → 16π = 352/7 ≈ 50.29

⇒ Area left = 280 − 50.29 ≈ 229.71 m²

**∴ The correct answer is ≈ 229.7 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Rectangle

Area = Length × Breadth

Area of Circle

Area = πr²

Use of π

For exams, use π = 22/7 or 3.14 depending on requirement

Multiple Shapes

Subtract areas of inner shapes from total outer area
